# a control that was mandated, never written, and never noticed

An ADR required the board to carry a "Mode B: not certified" note from the moment the board
existed. It never did -- not when the board was born, not through the next phase.

For the entire window in which the thing was unsupported, the artifact that was supposed to
say so said nothing. It was found by a task whose job was to DELETE that note.
